title: Telecom RAN Engineer
summary: Telecom RAN engineers keep the radio part of a 4G or 5G mobile network (the towers and the cells they serve) working well. They work for operators, equipment vendors or service partners, using drive tests and network KPIs (key performance indicators) to find and fix coverage, drop and speed problems.
dailyDuties: Check daily KPI reports for worst cells and drops
Plan and analyse drive tests and site verifications
Trace failures through Layer 3 messages and logs
Validate new sites and upgrades after integration
Share findings with operator teams and field engineers

skills.expectation: Track 4G and 5G KPIs and tune parameters to fix drops, throughput and coverage
Plan drive tests and analyse logs in TEMS, Nemo, XCAL or Actix
Read Layer 3 messages and call flows to find the cause of failures
Build daily and weekly KPI reports
Use pivots and lookups to slice KPI data by site and cell
Report findings to operator teams and coordinate field engineers
Work out root causes from KPIs, alarms and logs
Understand IP transport between sites and the core
